platform: CKUW 95.9 FM Winnipeg Music Director Digital Download and Physical Airplay Route
manual_review_reason: CKUW explicitly rejects unsolicited MP3 attachments and directs digital submissions to its Music Director using a high-quality downloadable link. The public guidance does not specify complete accepted codecs, minimum bitrate, release age, rights language, metadata fields, response timing or AI-origin policy. A human must confirm current requirements, select a suitable MarcsMusic release, prepare a permitted high-quality download link and concise metadata, verify rights and content labels, and send manually. Optional cassette, CD, vinyl or reel-to-reel delivery also requires manual handling.

platform: 101.5 UMFM CJUM Winnipeg Music Department Download-Link and Physical CD Route
manual_review_reason: UMFM accepts digital submissions only through a secure downloadable link and rejects individual audio-file attachments. The official FAQ permits WeTransfer, Dropbox, Google Drive, Bandcamp, DISCO or embedded links, accepts physical EPs only when they contain at least four songs, and does not state complete codec, bitrate, metadata, rights, release-window, AI-origin or response requirements. The official email is exposed through a Cloudflare-protected link and was deliberately not decoded or stored. A human must open the authorized link on the official FAQ, confirm the current address and requirements, verify release eligibility and rights, prepare the download link and metadata, and send manually.
